company.name: Midori Network
company.shortDescription: Midori Network is a distributed network of container-based mobile recycling modules.
company.description: Midori Network builds a global network of container-based mobile recycling modules that convert plastic waste from rural areas into recycled polymer materials and construction products. The company aims to address two major global issues simultaneously: increasing plastic pollution and the shortage of affordable housing in the Global South.

productsAndServices.description: A system of container-based mobile units deployed in remote rural areas to collect, sort, shred, and recycle plastic waste into building materials.
productsAndServices.name: Distributed Network of Mobile Recycling Modules

productsAndServices.description: Construction materials produced from recycled plastic waste processed near dumpsites to lower logistics and operational costs.
productsAndServices.name: Recycled Plastic Building Materials

productsAndServices.description: Eyewear frames handcrafted from recycled plastic bottle caps and milk jars, fitted with biodegradable lenses and medical-grade silicone components.
productsAndServices.name: Eyewear Made from Recycled Plastic
